[spoiler=[b]2027/6/18: Storming Of The Parliament Building[/b]]

As of today, nearly all schools across Lamandica have closed for the summer. In Taultion, students, especially seniors, have planned parties and festivities for the first night of school break, but as of a few nights ago, curfews have been enacted for many Lamandican citizens, such as those in Taultion. These students, who had their night squandered, still wanted to participate in something, and with rumors of something major happening tonight in Taultion as part of the Tax Day Riots, why not join something historic?

From 18:00 EET to 20:00 EET, a large crowd of protesters assembled behind the House Of The Unified Confederacy on Guadetero Street. The protest was very peaceful and routine at first, with statements, signs, anti-government sentiment, and police presence minimal at first. However, the crowd only grew larger as the sun began to set as news of it spread across social media, which led more police officers to arrive on the scene and start to form a line around the House Of The Unified Confederacy. The crowd in Downtown Taultion eventually grew to an estimated 2,100.

Around 19:57 EET, the crowd, mostly made of twenty-somethings, started to move out, bypassing the House Of The Unified Confederacy and causing minor vandalism. Police lines mostly successfully stopped any protesters from the building, with a few arrests being made. However, the crowd continued past the House, too fast for the police to catch up with. The crowd marched down Defiance Gardens toward the Parliamentary Building. The large open space of the Gardens gave protesters enough space for the protesters to spread out, and by 20:30 EET, they had surrounded the under-policed, vulnerable Parliamentary Building, which still had representatives inside.

Parliament had just finished discussing a new environmental law when they started receiving alerts that a large crowd of rioters was approaching the building rapidly. A crowd of rioters, furious with them. Representative Victoria Balzigis Elemwin of Gourcovencia province decided to call the session early and urged members to shelter throughout the building. While most did, a few did scramble toward their cars and fled in the nick of time. However, Representative Reginaldo C. Ousamesoit of Olnedos province was indecisive and got to his car as protesters surrounded him. Being a larger supporter of taxes to offset costs of Horgingtonia, he was a larger target. Just as he tried to get in his car, he was allegedly ripped out and slammed against another by a group of more disgruntled protesters and was beaten and robbed. He later would state, they tore the clothes off of me, and spray-painted TRAITOR on my back. The same people who got me here too.

The first breach of the building occurred around 21:03 EET from the right wing. Rocks were thrown at windows. People rammed into doors. One report even stated some tried to drive into the building. By this time, more police and National Guard members arrived to disperse the protesters using less lethal force, but a large percentage of them were already in the Parliamentary Building. Representative Chavamaldo R. Mayadon of Lyseloming province later described the setting as chaotic. Chairs were thrown, priceless artwork was ripped off the walls and destroyed There were some small fires ignited, nothing major from what I heard some slurring, asking where those [expletive] were at

Rioters turned the building upside down. They entered various rooms and vandalized desks and walls, as well as knocked out windows for more to get inside. One protestor allegedly urinated on a series of important documents. Some even entered the main chamber, where security cameras caught protestors tearing out carpet, spray-painting walls, and using hammers to destroy chairs and desks. Though most representatives were safely secure during the event, such as Representative Juliana Smith McAlester of Mirnisson province, who described the experience as the most frightening experience in her life. Some, like Paul Thornton LaCheamlynn, were found and suffered minor injuries at the hands of the protestors. Fortunately, police did eventually start filling in. They deployed tear gas on large groups of protestors to disperse them and arrested those they could.

Alas, protestors and police would frequently clash, which led to 7 deaths and 193 injuries. The deaths of Officer Chad R. Vancleave and Colby Rixiar Cetundwick became hot topics nationwide over the following weeks due to their preventability, with the family of the latter later suing the city of Taultion for 4 million Pelops. Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz issued many statements on the internet urging the protestors to disband. Eventually, police were able to control the situation, making over a thousand arrests that night and in the coming weeks. Protestors started fleeing as police presence grew, and by midnight, the riot was finally over.

The Parliamentary Building Breach started to mark the end for the Tax Day Riots, as many were deterred after this event. The last protest would occur on June 26th. Police saw criticism due to excessive force and allowing such an incident to occur, especially when it came to the lack of security at the Parliamentary Building itself. In the wake of the event, many members of Parliament would resign, including Representatives Elemwin, Ousamesoit, Mayadon, McAlester, and LaCheamlynn, just a year before the 2028 Parliamentary Elections. This event also called Prime Minister Calieno-Ruizs authority into question, with many hoping to now replace him in 2030, with this not portraying Lamandica in a good light internationally. Domestically, it would take a lot for those in Burgessminster Park to recover from a blow like this. [/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]An Imerrian Touch[/b]][i]
1st Of June, 2027


Archbishop Winchester met with Senior Bishop Hammond & Head of the College of Bishop, Vice Archbishop Carpenter, at the Palace of Aurestia, the Residence of the Archbishop and Former Residence of the now seemingly disbanded Royal Family, however the three met for not reasons concerning the Clergy, but the State, as the Church and State are one, with the new Diplomatic Ties made & Knotted, Geopolitical Alignments made, and Economic Expansion, and most Importantly, National Pride at an all-time high with Lagonda E1 and the Glorious win over Avalon in FEFA, the Divine Imerrian Kingdom seems to be doing fine on the outside, but in the inside? Royalists are still mad, they accept God as their King, as their Lord & Savior, but they still want their Earthly Royal Family back on the throne to take back power from the Church.

Archbishop Winchester sat at the Table of the Lord, and finally spoke up, as the resounding silence was far too great, We need to appease the Royalists, and frankly I believe having a Royal Family isnt all that bad of an Idea, as long as they kneel before good and follow the Church, whats the harm? They can act as mere bobble heads for the people to follow, they can use their knowledge and possible wisdom to lead the people, to maybe, but not lead them away from the lord.

The staunch anti-monarchist Vice Archbishop Carpenter spoke, This is madness, you realize this right? The only King, Emperor, whatever bloody title of a Savior or Leader belongs to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, not the Royal Family, and besides thats, theyve been gone since the 1700s and we need a full-blooded pure Royal to even meet the requirements, of which I highly doubt anybody meets, if we bring them any Royal in this country, nine times out of ten, theyll bloody be a half-blood, impure at that, not even Aurestian Christian at that!

The Archbishop Winchester, calmly replies, We cannot give up hope, we must seek to appease them, otherwise we will see this growth weve made so far dwindle and turn into Civil Unrest, and soon the Lords last remaining Bastion of Christianity will have Blood Shed on its soil once again, just like the Second Imerrian Civil War, there must be a way to appease these and keep the peace all whilst staying true to the lord, and by the way, watch your mouth here, this is the Table of the Lord, not some Saloon in the Divine State of South Avalon, where Frontiersmen and Outlaws do ungodly activities and use the devils language and indulge in the devils drink.

The Senior Bishop Hammond, sensing tension, and having a solution in mind, Gentlemen, we are all men of Religion, and Products of Honest, Imerrian, Compromise. I have personally been tracking this problem since its made itself a rather large issue, and I believe Ive concocted a rather clever solution, if I do say so myself, its a simple matter to say that we can or cant bring a royal to the simple-minded Royalists, that demand a Earthly Full-Blooded Royal on the Throne, we cant start another Royal Family, theyd be called Illegitimate, we cant pick up some poor girl and throw a crown on her like some animated movie from the 1940s would have you believe, but I have been looking into the Imerrian Aurestian Churchs Archives, our very own, dating back to 1534, I had a team of experts across the nation search for any traces, clues, evidence, of where a proper, full-blooded royal may or may not be at, and I think Ive found something, we have two options, a Sir Christian Taylor, or a Madam Mary Lancaster, I myself, believe we should go with Mary, and have Christian as a Backup Option if anything happens to Mary, as Christian, according to the Global Affairs Agency, seems to be rather un-Royal like, where as Mary seems to hold some sort of Etiquette, as she is raised by a rather wealthy family of I do say so myself, they even follow Aurestian Christianity as a bonus, I think weve got a Lock for this one, and as the church ourselves, we should go for a Queen, for the church is the Bride of Christ.

The Archbishop Winchester, with a smile, a faint one at that, looks at the Senior Bishop Hammond, and says, This Mary seems rather perfect for what we need, and Mary is quite a nice name, we wouldnt even need to change it, shes full-blooded, pure, and perfect for the job, although asking her to take the Position is unorthodox, and if they both deny?

The Vice Archbishop Carpenter continues the line of questions, Hes correct, what IF they do both deny, its not like one day being approached by a Western Theocracy to become their Pseudo-Head of State is a normal situation you can be prepared for, this is bonkers if Ive ever heard of it, and wed need to pass this by the College, but since you are the Party Leader of the College, and most Influential one in it, I assume you wont have much hard time with making the Bishops all agree with this, not unanimously, but a majority of them atleast.

The Senior Bishop Hammond replies, Colleagues, I assure you, theyll accept, theyll know that theyre doing a great deal of a job for their lord and savior, and as for convincing the College, Vice Archbishop Carpenter, as long as you dont get in the way, and let me do  my job, Ill have them convinced in no time, so, what do you say, Archbishop Winchester?

Archbishop Winchester replies, I want the Marines Prepared for this Mission, and more or so, I want them to take over the Island, we could do some good there too, and recruit more Royals, seeing as there could be more of them there, and possibly valuable resources to boost the economy with, I also want missionaries sent as well.

The Vice Archbishop Carpenter looks a bit shocked and says, Are you mad? Thats preposterous, you turned this from a Royal Recruitment Mission to a Full Expansion and restart of the Imerrian Glory Days where we sailed the seas, taking lands to civilize, Christianize, and do business in!

The Senior Archbishop Hammond nterrupts, I mean, the Economy does need resources, and simple Oil & Iron wont do, its a large island with plentiful resources, copper, uranium, etcetera, you know? Itll be highly lucrative, and think of all the business we can jumpstart there? Its not like anybody will mind, no?

The Vice Archbishop Carpenter, protests once more, We left the Colonialism a long time ago, when we stopped sailing the seas and decided to keep to ourselves, because

The Archbishop Winchester stops him, And look where that got us? Weve gone soft, simple, vulnerable, we stopped spreading Christ, and look where that got us now? In a domestic crisis with the Royalists, which we now have to send out marines to pick up a Queen for the long vacant Throne of Imerria! I will not have it Vice Archbishop Carpenter, I simply will not! We are going back to our roots once again and making that Island an Imerrian Mandate whether the people of said island like it or not!

The room falls silent once again, such as it was in the beginning, with the fireplace in the background crinkling as it was, the Vice Archbishop Carpenter stands up, and leaves, the Archbishop nods, dismissing the Senior Bishop Hammond, and the Archbishop Winchester sat all alone, at the Table of the Lord, in the Palace of Aurestia.

19th of June, 2027


Corporal John Cincinnatus woke up on  the Flight to Argos, landing on the rough surface of a horrible airfield as Fort Raphael could barely be called such, it was still being built, but alas, the Cruciati Marini Dei, or the Marines were still being shipped there, 2750 of them to be exact, 1,250 more were to arrive later, just to set up camp, and 17,500 Knights of the Divine Army of Imerria were to arrive when all was ready for them, for now, it was all about securing the Island, and securing Mary Lancaster.

It was a rather bumpy landing, and John stumbled out of the Aircraft Cargo Bay, they werent built for comfort, not exactly anyways.

John greeted his Commanding Officer, Sergeant Major Williams, and said, Sergeant Major Sir! I am Corporal-At-Arms John Cincinnatus Sir! Where are my Barracks Sir?

Sergeant Major Williams threw a duffel bag at him and then grabbed his clipboard, and wrote down Johns name, and then said, Your Barracks are wherever the hell someones hasnt made their tent in yet, so I suggest you make your tent before all the good spots are taken.

Lancaster saluted him and said, Sir, understood, Sir! And ran off with the duffel bag to a nice area, a small hill overlooking Fort Raphael, and poor ex his duffel bag, it was a medium sized tent, a Manuel to build it, some duct tape to fix tears, a small flask, a bible, a small sleeping bag, a lantern to keep warm, and a bottle of gasoline to keep the lantern on, as well as a multi-use knife, he set to work, building up his tent, and by then, he reported to the Mess Hall to get some food which he ate, it was rather bland, but still nutritious enough to keep anyone going, he reported to where most of his unit would be, and met up with a fellow Corporal-At-Arms, a fellow called Charles Blanc, who asked him, Got a lighter? and John passed him one, which Blanc said, thanks man. As he lit a cigarette, and passed it back to John, the Sergeant of the Unit then came up and everybody immediately came at attention, this was Sergeant LeClair, whom spoke to all of them, Alright! Listen up, were here to serve for the Lord and Clergy, but first, to do that, we need a base, which all of you will partake in the construction of, its not special,  it youre still serving the lord! Your job is simple, youre to go to the Northeast end of Base and provide protection for the Construction Workers and locals weve hired which are build a a perimeter, chop, chop! Go on! Git

John went off to get his Service Rifle, which he made sure was clean, loaded, and on safety, he didnt want to make a bad impression, he then hitched a ride on a Babel-1 to the Northeast area of the Base, and went to take his Position, with again, Charles, and John said, Hello again, Blanc, care for a game of cards?

Blanc looked at him, John spoke weirdly, but in this situation, it didnt really matter much, and accepted his offer, Sure, John, why the hell not?
The two played cards for a while, nothing much interesting happened until a bullet whizzed by and they took cover, and Blanc shouted, WERE UNDER FIRE! NEED BACKUP

John shot back, and so did Blanc but barely, they were pinned and couldnt retreat, unless they wanted to get shot at, so Blanc and John decided on a plan of action, Blanc would provide cover fire, and John would advanced towards the enemy.

Blanc went on full-auto, and unleashed all his fire power on e enemy, and John advanced to cover; which was a rock that was sufficient, and he saw the enemy, he tried to get a clear shot until a sniper got a shot at  the enemy, John took a sigh of relief, he wasnt really ready to take the shot, and so was Blanc, as he got grazed once or twice.

The pair were reassigned, to a safer position, mostly to get a sigh of relief, all in all, this would be a hard campaign for the Imerrian Armed Forces.

Somewhere else, June 20th, 2027


A convoy of Babel-1s, Babel 2s, and Babel Ts as well as a few SRT-76s were on their way to a Ranch, all in all, it was around 175 soldiers that were in this convoy? Headed by Knight Commander Oscar Fairfax, to recruit the one and only full-blooded, pure, Mary Lancaster, the heir to the Imerrian Throne, besides Christian Taylor, a lesser option to the Throne, and she would be the solution to appeasing the Royalists.

As the first of the Vehicles entered the Ranch, and Fairfax exited the Babel-1, and was met by Marys family, whom were all outside, confused as to why there was so many foreign military vehicles at their Ranch, he greeted them, and said, Hello, I assumed all of you are the Lancasters, you speak Imerrian? or Modern Enochian? I imagine atleast a version of it, we are here for Mary Lancaster, she is the heir to the Imerrian Throne, and wed like her to take it, as it has been vacant for over 200+ years.

Mary stepped up to the Knight Commander, but her mother stopped her and said, You are not taking my daughter to inherit some far away little kingdom! She is not something you can take and put on a throne!

Mary stopped her mother, and say, Mom! Im 25, Im more than old enough to make my own decisions, and if theyre offering me to literally become a queen, Im going to obviously say yes!

But her mother stopped her once more, Mary Whiton Lancaster! You do not speak to me like that! I am your mother and you do not get to talk to me like that! Her father stepped in and said, Elizabeth, let her make her choice, these men aint gonna take her away from us, theyre offering her a choice, and we aint exactly armed enough to refuse, seeing as they have a couple hundred men, a convoy, and helicopter, so let Mary make her choice.

Elizabeth replied, You too, Joseph?! Unbelievable, theyre going to take her away to a far away land!

But Joseph stopped her, And theyll treat her good, youre a bit ill-educated, but the place theyre taking her aint no dump, its a theocracy, a fancy one, developed, they can defend themselves, and that means they can defend and take care of Mary.

Elizabeth relented, and turned to Mary, and said, Fine Mary, would you like to agree to become the Queen of Imerria?

Mary look at her family, and the military convoy, she knew Imerria was a Western nation, a fancy one at that, they made those Lagonda Cars that her dad collected, and theyre real nice maybe Imerria will be just as good as those cars are she looked at Fairfax, and said, Yes, Ill agree to become the Queen of Imerria.

Fairfax replied, Great, lets move quickly, theres an active resistance and if they find out were here for you, youll become the most wanted woman on this Island, say your goodbyes and were off.

Aurestia, Imerria, June 21st, 2027.


A Crusader enter the Dormitory of Archbishop Winchester, and said, Your Holiness, weve found her, shes alive, and willingly agreed to inherit the throne, Sir Oscar Fairfax, a Knight Commander of the Divine Imerrian Army has her and she is on her way to Fort Raphael and back to Aurestia, shall we prepare her for her coronation?

The Archbishop Winchester replies, Yes, Immediately at once, I want you to go get the Vice Archbishop and Senior Bishop at once.

A couple hours later.


All three members meet at the Table of God once again, and the Archbishop speaks once again, It is to my knowledge that Sir Oscar Fairfax has Mary Lancaster, and she is enroute for Aurestia, she is to have a proper coronation at Wilson Cathedral, Senior Bishop Hammond, how had convincing the College gone?

The Senior Bishop Hammond speaks, Swimmingly, Archbishop, we have the Majority to pass it through the College of Bishops, all is left now is to for you to sign off on her coronation, and to actually coronate her, of which then, she shall be named Queen of Imerria & will act as a figurehead for Imerria and Head of State, as well as Diplomatic stuff, the usual for the likes of her.

The Archbishop Winchester nods, and asks the Vice Archbishop Carpenter, Vice Archbishop, do you have any objections, as despite everything seemingly go the right path, I do know of your anti-monarchist sentiments, and while I share some, this is all for the better of the nation, and it will finally put someone in the throne, that is simply lovely if I say so myself?

The Vice Archbishop Carpenter says, If this is the change the Kingdom seeks, I dont see why Ill try to stand in the flow of it, for it shall simply go around me, but I warn you of this, when she starts consolidating power, I will be there to say, I told you say, for a Monarch that is influential enough and given the right platform, can easily override this Government and force it to act against our own will, what if she acts tyrannical? Or against Gods will.

Archbishop Winchester replies, Nonsense, shes as loyal as they come, according to the Global Affairs Agency, she wouldnt betray us, she doesnt even know how to lead, shes a farm girl from Argos that just happened to be a pure-blooded royal, relax yourself.

The Senior Bishop Hammond speaks up, True, and even if we lose control of her, we always have Christian, we can replace her with him and theyd still be happy, I believe this is still jolly good news.

Archbishop Winchester says, Agreed,  you lot are all dismissed. They both leave, but Winchester does have his doubts, what if Carpenter really does have a point? What if Mary rises up with power, what if she topples the church and makes herself the head of church AND state? Time would tell, still, he needs to decide whether to invite the colonials from Hayan-Dal & Diplomats from fellow EDU aligned states hell be busy.[/i][/spoiler]
